keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «가짜 약을 먹어도 많은 환자가 나아졌다고 느낀다(주제)» 와 «마음은 몸의 느낌에 영향을 주지만 진짜 약을 대신할 수는 없다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (many patients feel better after a placebo) and the conclusion (the mind affects how the body feels but cannot replace medicine). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The placebo effect: feeling better after a fake pill
Expectation and a caring setting help the brain reduce pain
It eases pain or stress but cannot cure an infection

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: A placebo is a pill with no active
. Still, many patients who take it say they feel
, which helps the brain release chemicals that reduce
. However, a placebo cannot cure an
, so belief cannot replace real medicine.

words: This fake treatment is called a placebo.
a fake pill or treatment with no real medicine in it
a pill that contains no active medicine
able to cause a real effect in the body
a belief that something will happen
feeling sure that things will go well
It can ease symptoms like pain or stress
signs that you are sick, like pain or a fever
it cannot shrink a tumor or cure an infection
to make a sick person healthy again

qs.q: Why are new drugs tested against placebos?
opts: to see whether the medicine works better than belief alone
to make the new drugs cheaper to sell
evs: This fake treatment is called a placebo.
That is why new drugs are tested against placebos, so researchers can see whether a medicine works better than belief alone.
The setting of treatment matters too, as a caring doctor and a familiar medical routine can make people feel more confident.
Their pain may decrease, or they may sleep more easily, even though the pill itself does nothing.
why: 연구자들이 그 약이 믿음만으로 생기는 효과보다 더 잘 듣는지 보기 위해서라고 했어요.
Researchers want to see whether a medicine works better than belief alone.

qs.q: In "The setting of treatment matters too," what does "setting" mean?
qs.qko: «The setting of treatment matters too» 에서 «setting» 은 무엇을 뜻하나요?
opts: the people and surroundings where treatment happens
the time when a pill is swallowed
evs: Scientists believe it happens partly because of expectation: when people expect to improve, the brain can release natural chemicals that reduce pain.
In medical research, some patients are given a pill that contains no active medicine, such as a sugar pill.
The setting of treatment matters too, as a caring doctor and a familiar medical routine can make people feel more confident.
It can ease symptoms like pain or stress, but it cannot shrink a tumor or cure an infection.
why: 같은 문장에서 친절한 의사와 익숙한 진료 과정을 예로 들어요. 즉 치료가 이루어지는 환경과 분위기예요.
The same sentence gives a caring doctor and a familiar medical routine as examples, so "setting" means the surroundings of treatment.

qs.q: Can a placebo help a patient with an infection get well?
qs.qko: 플라세보가 감염된 환자를 낫게 할 수 있을까요?
opts: No. It can ease symptoms, but it cannot cure an infection.
Yes, if the patient believes in it strongly enough.
Yes, because sugar pills kill germs.
evs: However, the placebo effect has clear limits.
Surprisingly, many patients who take a placebo report that they feel better.
It can ease symptoms like pain or stress, but it cannot shrink a tumor or cure an infection.
Scientists believe it happens partly because of expectation: when people expect to improve, the brain can release natural chemicals that reduce pain.
why: 글은 플라세보 효과에 분명한 한계가 있고, 증상은 덜어 줄 수 있어도 감염을 치료하지는 못한다고 말해요.
The text says the placebo effect has clear limits: it can ease symptoms but cannot cure an infection.

ends: Find out how scientists design fair tests for new medicines.
과학자들이 신약을 공정하게 시험하는 방법을 알아봐요.
Learn how stress and mood can change the way our bodies feel.
스트레스와 기분이 몸의 느낌을 어떻게 바꾸는지 알아봐요.

write.src: “It is important to <u>take real medicine for an infection</u> because <u>a placebo cannot cure it</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write an important action and your reason in English.

chips.b: a tired brain makes more mistakes
chips.label: sleep

chips.a: see a doctor when a fever lasts
chips.label: doctor

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가/무엇이 + 어떻게 된다» 를 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because stress makes my hands cold)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who or what + what happens to make your reason clear. (e.g. because stress makes my hands cold)
